purpose: Vehicle-scoped recorded warranty coverage, projected expiry, factual claim readiness, claim ledger and evidence provenance.
primaryGoal: Understand which coverage limit binds and record coverage/claim history without confusing projections with contract interpretation or filing a legal submission.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: internal\app\ownershipintelsvc\warranty.go:184-275; durable warranties and claims plus vehicle snapshot and trailing server-defined driving window
dataSources.behavior: Positive vehicle enablement, scope-specific ownership-intel key, AbortSignal forwarded. Overview supplies coverages, readiness, claims, SI odometer, quality, evidence, as_of and digest. Fixed server pace window is not a header-selected date range.
items null-safe in page; handler returns items and total; independent source state from overview
Typed bodies, existing mutation toast/error pipeline, ownership-intel invalidation. Delete requires danger confirmation. Claim is a local record, not provider filing. No mutation was executed.

dataSources.endpoint: useVehicles dependency; endpoint implementation not expanded in this audit
dataSources.owner: workspace selection hook and selectedVehicle store
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, store and fleet fallback; no duplicate page picker. workspaceScope.ts:156-174 evaluates this route as vehicle=true, range=false.

dataSources.owner: existing formatting/preferences hooks and shared OperationalBrief pipeline
dataSources.behavior: Display formatting only; settings endpoint dependencies not recursively expanded. Warranty wire types use m, s, m_per_s, percentages and ISO currency minor units.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing category barrel; width/container and existing shell; query is header freshness metadata, not page fatal replacement.

components.name: OwnershipPanel
components.contract: Domain adapter over LayoutCard/SourceContent; source/sourceEnabled/empty/editing/preserveSummary; localized retry and independent retained source content.

components.name: OwnershipBrief
components.contract: OperationalBrief and useOperationalMetrics; rawValue/metricId/display, selected scope, source freshness and missing-state reporting.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Three persistent tableIds; typed column renderers/filter values, mobileColumns, existing table/export controller. Mobile details/actions require explicit mobilePresentation opt-in.

components.name: Input / Select / Textarea / Button / Badge / Text / ConfirmDialog
components.contract: Shared primitives already used; keyboard/focus/runtime acceptance not inferred.

components.name: MoneyInput / SiNumberInput
components.contract: Canonical minor units and SI typed fields; preferred-unit hints; null handling and native numeric bounds.

components.name: EvidencePanel / VerdictBadge / MutationError
components.contract: Domain provenance/limitations, status tone, inline write failure; reuse rather than page-local replacements.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Existing useMotionPreference path; reduced initial=false and duration from preference. Browser/OS behavior unverified.

components.name: UsageBar
components.contract: Local labeled percent/hint visual; dynamic width is valid, not static-style violation.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Coverage card, battery inset and claim editor repeat raw fixed-white surface styling; EvidencePanel evidence rows repeat the same domain surface pattern.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing LayoutCard/Card and canonical neutral surface tokens without adding another warranty card framework.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Time and distance meters use one local UsageBar already; cross-page recurrence was not established.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep local unless independent consumers establish a shared need; do not speculatively create a shared meter.

responsive.existing: Coverage flex wrap and md three-column meters; warranty editor md two/xl three columns; claim editor md two columns; evidence lg three columns; digest break-all.

issues.detail: Warranty table mobileColumns excludes actions, floor and deductible. No mobilePresentation or expandable fallback is supplied. DataTable's normal cells apply colHiddenClass and its mobile adapter is opt-in, so Claim/Remove are hidden below md rather than reachable as mobile actions.
issues.fix: Use existing mobilePresentation roles/displayValue, allDetails and inlineActions to expose every term and both actions. Preserve confirmation, pending state and tableId.

issues.detail: Readiness hides detail below md; claims at line 873 hide amount and evidence note. Neither table supplies a full-detail mobile alternative.
issues.fix: Adopt existing mobile presentation/details, keeping all three tables' complete records, loaded filtering/export semantics and source ordering.

issues.detail: Coverage label/status row does not wrap or establish a min-width/wrapping strategy; outer row wraps but long inner labels may still overflow.
issues.fix: Add token-compatible min-w-0 and safe wrap behavior and validate long provider/label/status text at allocated 320px width.

accessibility.status: keyboard, screen-reader, focus, targets and composed contrast unverified
accessibility.existing: Shared labeled fields, explicit submit/cancel buttons, localized delete confirmation, decorative action icons aria-hidden, shared reduced-motion entrance path.

issues.detail: Readiness state renderer consists only of CheckCircle2/XCircle marked aria-hidden. It exposes no satisfied/unmet text, leaving the State cell without an accessible value. DataTable text extraction also skips aria-hidden content.
issues.fix: Add localized visible or screen-reader text for satisfied/unmet; retain icons as decoration and supply corresponding mobile/export text.

issues.detail: Add coverage toggles an inline form without aria-expanded/aria-controls. Claim opens an editor in a later section without an explicit target label or focus transfer.
issues.fix: Associate toggle/editor with stable IDs, expanded state and claim target text; use existing focus mechanisms rather than a new overlay. Verify keyboard return/cancel behavior.

issues.detail: UsageBar has visible percent/hint text but no semantic meter association. Dynamic width is acceptable; visual color is not the sole information channel.
issues.fix: If upgraded, use shared progress/meter semantics with localized accessible label/value and preserve the text/hint; first verify whether an existing primitive fits.

states.loading: OwnershipPanel:40-48 maps initial loading to SourceContent skeleton; summary preserves OwnershipBrief loading presentation.
states.empty: Coverage/readiness/register/ledger each retain panel shell and localized messages. EvidencePanel independently reports unavailable quality and absent evidence.
states.error: Fatal source failure stays in OwnershipPanel and forwards retry. Register remains independent of failed overview; mutation errors remain inline.
states.stale: OwnershipPanel preserves data via retained SourceContent and retry. OwnershipBrief reports retained source with observation/client load timestamp.
states.offline: DataState exposes isRefreshBlocked; retained paused fetch maps to stale. Page/domain adapter do not explicitly distinguish offline pending from ordinary empty.
states.unknown: Overview metrics use nullable raw values rather than default-zero measurements; projections retain quality reasons. Optional capacity and pace remain optional.

issues.detail: Without retained data, a paused initial query is typically isPending=true/isLoading=false. Adapter checks source.isLoading only and can render the caller's empty state, e.g. 'No warranties recorded yet', although register was never loaded. It also reduces retained offline to generic retained copy.
issues.fix: Extend existing domain adapter to distinguish unresolved/paused source from authoritative empty, consume DataState/isPending/isRefreshBlocked and provide explicit offline prerequisite/recovery text without blanking retained data.

visualIssues.detail: Six fixed-white border/background occurrences across coverage card, battery inset and claim editor do not use canonical theme surfaces. Effective contrast is not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border tokens and shared card composition; retain muted semantic readiness/warning color without a new palette.

visualIssues.detail: Readiness score uses raw p with text-lg/font-semibold; percent captions and digest also define text-xs/text-sm independently.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing metric/Text/Code typography roles, preserving tabular numbers, all values and digest wrapping.

visualIssues.detail: Evidence-source cards repeat fixed-white border/background styling inside the domain trailer.
visualIssues.fix: Domain owner replaces chrome with neutral surface tokens while preserving evidence source, summary, samples and timestamps.

architectureIssues.detail: claimFor is only a warranty ID and persists across header vehicle changes. submitClaim uses it without verifying that it belongs to current warranties; currency at line 159 derives from current overview. An editor opened for vehicle A can remain while the surrounding source switches to vehicle B.
architectureIssues.fix: Bind the unsaved editor to its original vehicle/warranty/currency and visibly preserve that identity; prevent submission under an inconsistent workspace. Do not silently discard drafts on scope change.

architectureIssues.detail: Claim amounts and claim editor use one overview currency rather than selected/parent warranty currency. Service warranty.go:224-226 sums claim minor units and :241-243 chooses first warranty currency; coverage form accepts per-row currency. Mixed-currency correctness is not established.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must define per-warranty claim currency and currency-aware totals without implicit conversion. Page should retain each claim's parent currency and selected-warranty identity; never fabricate exchange rates.

architectureIssues.detail: Readiness key uses warrantyLabel plus check code. Labels need not be unique and are editable human content; different warranties with same label can collide.
architectureIssues.fix: Carry warranty ID when flattening readiness and key by ID/code, retaining labels for presentation.

architectureIssues.detail: Coverage kind options render raw enum labels. Provider/kind metadata, binding limit, severity and VerdictBadge default status likewise show backend vocabulary instead of localized display labels. Claim form already has a localized status map.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize known display vocabulary through canonical catalogs/domain label adapters while preserving raw wire values and user/backend narratives verbatim. Catalog edits belong to integration owner.

Distinguish paused initial source from loaded empty
then: Localized enums and measured responsive/a11y validation

requiredSharedChanges.name: OwnershipPanel unresolved/offline source state
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Keep title/source/sourceEnabled/empty/editing/preserveSummary. Derive pending-without-data independently of authoritative empty; add an explicit paused/offline message/recovery through current SourceContent contract if necessary. Retained data and unsaved editor stay visible.
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Focused initial paused, offline retained, fatal retry, disabled selection and editing-without-data cases; no new trust renderer.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Ownership evidence neutral surfaces
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Keep quality/evidence/limitations/unsupported/source/sourceEnabled unchanged; token-only chrome replacement for evidence cards and semantic warnings.
usedBy: OwnershipBrief provenance description references the same evidence trailer
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Preserve full evidence rows, sample count, timestamps, reasons and unsupported statements in all themes.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Currency-aware warranty claim source contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing Warranty.currency is authoritative per coverage; claim amount_minor must retain parent currency. Total claimed requires currency grouping or explicit same-currency limitation, not an invented conversion.
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Mixed-currency and workspace-change evidence plus explicit API/UI preservation review; no backend change is authorized by this audit.

competingImplementations.disposition: Reuse DataTable.mobilePresentation and MobileDataTablePresentation; do not add local responsive tables/cards or another export controller.
Reuse OwnershipPanel, SourceContent, DataState and OperationalBrief; fix adapter rather than introduce another query state store.
Reuse LayoutCard/Card/Text and existing OperationalBrief metrics; do not create WarrantyCard/ModernCard/KPI replacement.
Keep header vehicle owner. No page vehicle/date picker: route intentionally has vehicle=true/range=false; coverage start date is a business field.

preservation.sectionStructure: Six OwnershipPanel instances plus one EvidencePanel, with three evidence subsections: Data quality, Evidence sources, Limitations. Terms warning precedes these sections.
dataBehavior: SI m/s/distance and ISO minor units remain unchanged on wire/cache
useUnits display conversion and saved locale/precision survive
Measured annual pace, binding limit, time/distance burn-down, battery retention/headroom/floor projection and optional closing window survive
Readiness label/detail/severity and factual narrative survive
Claim note/status/opened/amount and coverage terms remain reachable on mobile
Digest, source quality/reasons/timestamps and explicit legal/provider-filing exclusions remain
Source-specific loading/error/empty/retained behavior and mutation errors remain
AbortSignal, positive vehicle enablement, ownership keys/invalidation and danger confirmation remain
preservation.lineCountNote: Future >=70% root baseline may include extracted components in the feature; this audit changes no source and does not assert modernization parity.
